suites.title: 1. Primary user flow — JRN-01.1: Daily Expense Capture

specs.title: Opens the Expense Tracker application
Sees the expense form with amount, description, and category fields
Sees the total displayed in currency format
Fills the form with amount, description, and category
Submits the form and sees the new expense in the list
Sees a success toast after adding an expense
Form clears after successful submission and focus returns to amount
Total updates immediately after adding an expense
Enters multiple expenses in sequence and all appear in the list

specs.title: Shows error when submitting with empty fields
Shows error for negative amount

suites.title: US-3.2: See Empty State When No Expenses Exist

specs.title: Empty state element exists in the HTML structure

suites.title: US-3.3: List Updates Immediately After Mutations

specs.title: New expense appears in list without page reload

suites.title: US-4.1: View Running Total of All Expenses

specs.title: Total increases after adding a new expense
